title: Open Challenges and Opportunities in Human-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.14846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly undertake extended tasks and act on people's behalf, making human-agent interaction central to their effectiveness. Successful interaction requires understanding human perspectives, coordinating complementary capabilities, and maintaining productive relationships within socio-technical environments. This paper examines how foundations developed by the Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems (AAMAS) community inform these demands. We consider interactions ranging from individual human-agent partnerships to teams and larger groups, where participants differ in their roles, decision authority, capabilities, and objectives. We organize computational approaches around the connected challenges of understanding others and deciding how to interact with them. translated_title: 人-智能体系统中的开放挑战与机遇
translated_abstract: 智能体AI系统日益承担扩展性任务并代表人类行事，这使得人-智能体交互成为其有效性的核心。成功的交互需要理解人类视角、协调互补的能力，并在社会技术环境中维持富有成效的关系。本文考察了自主智能体与多智能体系统（AAMAS）社区所发展的理论基础如何满足这些需求。我们考虑了从个体人-智能体协作到团队乃至更大群体的各类交互场景，其中参与者在角色、决策权、能力和目标上各不相同。我们围绕两个相互关联的挑战——理解他人以及决定如何与之交互——来组织相关计算方法。心理理论、信念-愿望-意图（BDI）架构、目标与计划识别、逆向规划以及递归推理为表征（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文系统梳理了AAMAS社区的基础方法（如心理理论、BDI架构、目标与计划识别、逆向规划、递归推理）如何支撑从个体协作到团队层面的人-智能体交互，并指出了在理解他人与交互决策方面的开放挑战与机遇。
en_tdlr: This paper surveys how AAMAS foundations—Theory of Mind, BDI architectures, goal and plan recognition, inverse planning, and recursive reasoning—address open challenges in human-agent interaction, from individual partnerships to team and group coordination.
